decision_rationale: The sections describe Med-PaLM M as a generalist biomedical AI system and explicitly say a task was set up “in a generative framework through a language decoder.” The model is also described as foundation-model-like, with large-scale pretraining and transfer to many downstream tasks.
evidence_snippet: “in a generative framework through a language decoder” and “trained on large-scale data with self-supervised or unsupervised objectives” and “generalize to unseen biomedical concepts and tasks”
